name: SQUIRT GAME 💦
source: You signed up for an adult reality show, and now your dignity is the first thing to go. Tease your rivals, exploit their filthy fantasies, and do whatever it takes to win. The prize is huge, but the temptation is even bigger!
translation: 你报名参加了一档成人真人秀节目，如今最先丢掉的就是你的节操与尊严。挑逗你的竞争对手，利用她们最下流的幻想弱点，为赢下比赛不择手段吧。巨额奖金固然诱人，但眼前的肉体诱惑还要更大！
